name: Osric's Crate
summary: At Sentinel Hill, Osric's Crate brings fresh armor from Stormwind to the People's Militia. The defenders face the Defias Brotherhood and marauding gnolls without the Stormwind army.

sections.title: Supplies for the Front
sections.body: Quartermaster Lewis receives the shipment and shares the protective gear among the volunteer fighters. The crown gives the People's Militia no formal support. These freshly made suits are meant to help the volunteers hold their position.

sections.title: Winged Courier Network
sections.body: From Dungar Longdrink's roost in Stormwind's Trade District, a gryphon carries the crate to Thor at Sentinel Hill. The flight avoids dangerous roads through Elwynn Forest and across the Westfall border, where bandits may ambush travelers. Gryphons help keep frontier garrisons supplied during wartime.

faq.answer: Osric's Crate holds protective armor crafted in Stormwind. Quartermaster Lewis receives the delivery and prepares to distribute it among the fighters defending Sentinel Hill.
Osric is an armorer in Stormwind who prepared the shipment for the People's Militia holding Westfall.

aliases: who do i give osric's crate to
faq.answer: Quartermaster Lewis receives the crate. He manages supplies and equipment for the People's Militia at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.

faq.q: Why is the crate delivered by gryphon?
faq.answer: Bandits and outlaws make the roads through Stormwind, Elwynn Forest, and Westfall perilous. A gryphon carries the armor quickly and safely from Dungar Longdrink in Stormwind to Thor at Sentinel Hill.

angles.text: For the Alliance, every shipment of arms and armor that reaches Sentinel Hill helps keep the kingdom's western borders from falling to the Defias Brotherhood.
